summary: Tested Trophy Room (Iter 68): backend league + team trophy-room endpoints AND frontend nostalgic /trophy-room and /trophy-room/team/:teamId pages. Backend: 7/7 pytest test_trophy_room.py PASS. Live curl confirms response shape: 6 seasons (2017,2018,2019,2020,2024,2025), 5 team_banners groups, 3 hall_of_fame entries (capped at 8, sorted desc). Frontend: /trophy-room renders trophy-room-page testid with the requested dark/gold/wood aesthetic — 10 banners hanging from rafter with correct testids (e.g. trophy-banner-presidents_trophy-2025, trophy-banner-division-2025), 18 trophies in display case with gold gradient circles, 3 Hall of Fame plaques (Connor McDavid, Andrei Vasilevskiy, Evan Bouchard) showing initials avatar + LEGEND badge + last 3 trophies, 5 team-room-card-{teamId} cards. Filter buttons (filter-all, filter-recent) present. Sidebar 'Trophy Room' link present. Click on team-room-card-... navigates to /trophy-room/team/{teamId} which renders team-banners-rafter + exit-team-room-btn (back to League Room). Visual aesthetic matches the reference HTML: cinzel/playfair fonts, amber/gold accents, dark wood tones, hanging banner chevron bottoms, rope hangers — looks great.

ui_bugs.issue: data-testid for individual trophies omits the year. Generated as `trophy-item-${label.toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g,'-')}` -> e.g. 'trophy-item-season-mvp', BUT spec requires year suffix like 'trophy-item-season-mvp-2025'. As a result, when the same award appears across multiple seasons, every trophy element shares the same data-testid (duplicates), making per-season testid lookups impossible. Fix: include trophy.year in the testid: `trophy-item-${slug}-${trophy.year}`.

Each trophy in the Individual Trophies display case shows the player name + owner team but NO season year. With 6 seasons of identical 'Season MVP — Connor McDavid · C — on Zarek's Frozen' tiles, the user cannot distinguish which year each trophy is for. Recommend appending the year to the plaque (e.g., '2025 · on Zarek's Frozen').

issues: No season year shown on individual trophy plaques — hard to distinguish duplicate awards across years

action_items: Update TrophyDisplay data-testid in /app/frontend/src/lovable/pages/TrophyRoom.tsx (line 90) to include the year: `trophy-item-${labelSlug}-${trophy.year}`. Without the year, all same-award trophies share one testid (e.g. 'trophy-item-season-mvp' repeated 6x).
Optional: render trophy.year in the trophy plaque caption (display case) so users can see which season each trophy is from.
